description: User stream (docs/message-sync.md#user-stream): one live REQ for all of the account's rooms, chosen by the relay per account. Read by desktop (relayUserStream.test.mjs and the store tests) and mobile (user_stream_fixture_test.dart and the store tests). Times are unix seconds unless a key ends in Ms. Room ids are opaque strings; room lists are sets, listed by id, unless the key is `batches` or `rooms` of a batch (ordered). Sections: `part1` (parse snapshot parts in arrival order on the stream sub; `eose` true means EOSE came after them; `accept` false means CLOSE the stream, chunks for this connection), `modes` (what each mode does), `storeSkip` (which stream frames the store keeps: `eose` is the stream EOSE, `req` re-sends the REQ on the same id, `close` is the client CLOSE, `closed` a relay CLOSED; `badKinds` marks a part 1 whose kinds differ from the frozen kinds), `closed` (reason -> action: chunks = stream off for this connection, chunks stay or carry everything; fallback = the mid-connection fallback; awaitSocketClose = no fallback, wait up to 2 s for the relay to close the socket, then close it, then reconnect normally; retryAfterAuth = resend after the next AUTH OK, only before the stream EOSE in live/gated), `backoff` (closes that count are `full`, `closed` and `other` after the stream EOSE in live/gated; `lagged` and `shadow_full` never count), `busyRetry` (history REQs ended by `error: busy`), `epoch`, `snapshot` (per-room classes at stream EOSE and what each mode does with them), `skipCoverage`, `connectionSpans` (`connectedAt` is the connection's start time, recorded before any chunk REQ is answered; catch-up resume points and the new-row base use only coverage that began before it, so an EOSE span [C, C] from a chunk on the same connection is ignored; `segments` are room-a's, `since` its walk start, `head` its new-row base), `batching` (`stale` rooms are taken out before batching and not walked), `ruleW` (steps -> room_seq rows [seq, at]), `clearing`, `newRow`, `skipVerification`, `auditSampling`, `auditVerdicts`, `liveMissed`, `lastFrame`, `comparator` (shadow counters), `handoff`, `midConnectionClosed`, `spanStop` (the stream's own coverage span), `chunkCatchUp` (which rooms a chunk's own catch-up and repair still walk), `membership` (44100/44101 in live/gated), `routing` (stream frames in live/gated).
